tide-pool-intro: Guess what will happen. Then try it and watch!
tide-pool-help: Make a prediction, then try the habitat change. Look at what happens. Choose an answer from what you observed.
tide-pool-q-snail: What will the snail eat? The green fuzz, the fish, or the sand?
tide-pool-do-snail: Now add the snail, and watch!
tide-pool-right-snail: You guessed it! Snails eat the green fuzz on rocks. It's called algae!
tide-pool-surprise-snail: Surprise! Snails eat the green fuzz on rocks. It's called algae!
tide-pool-q-crab: Where will the hermit crab live? In a sea star, an empty shell, or the seaweed?
tide-pool-do-crab: Now add the hermit crab, and watch!
tide-pool-right-crab: You guessed it! Hermit crabs live in empty shells. The shell keeps their soft body safe.
tide-pool-surprise-crab: Surprise! Hermit crabs live in empty shells. The shell keeps their soft body safe.
tide-pool-q-seaweed: What helps the seaweed grow? Dark clouds, sunshine, or more sand?
tide-pool-do-seaweed: Now bring out the sun, and watch!
tide-pool-right-seaweed: You guessed it! Seaweed uses sunshine to make its own food, so it grows!
tide-pool-surprise-seaweed: Surprise! Seaweed uses sunshine to make its own food, so it grows!
tide-pool-q-tide: The tide goes out. What happens? More water, or less water?
tide-pool-do-tide: Now send the tide out, and watch!
tide-pool-right-tide: You guessed it! At low tide the sea moves away, so the pool gets shallow. The tide comes back later.
tide-pool-surprise-tide: Surprise! At low tide the sea moves away, so the pool gets shallow. The tide comes back later.
tide-pool-q-fish: What does a fish breathe from? Air, water, or sand?
tide-pool-do-fish: Now add the fish, and watch!
tide-pool-right-fish: You guessed it! Fish breathe with gills. Gills take oxygen out of the water.
tide-pool-surprise-fish: Surprise! Fish breathe with gills. Gills take oxygen out of the water.
tide-pool-q-heat: What does hot water do to coral? Does it grow bigger, or turn white?
tide-pool-do-heat: Now make the water hot, and watch!
tide-pool-right-heat: You guessed it! Too much heat makes coral lose its tiny helpers and turn white. Cool water helps it get better.
tide-pool-surprise-heat: Surprise! Too much heat makes coral lose its tiny helpers and turn white. Cool water helps it get better.
tide-pool-q-coral: The coral is sad. Make the coral happy! Try the sun, the water, and the tide.
tide-pool-coral-happy: The coral is happy! Coral needs sunshine, cool water, and to stay underwater.
float-sink-intro: Will it float or sink? Tap your guess!
float-sink-help: Choose float or sink, then watch the object. Later, try loading a boat. You can ask for help at any time.
float-sink-object-leaf: Leaf. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-leaf: You guessed it! A dry leaf is light for its size, so it floats.
float-sink-surprise-leaf: Surprise! A dry leaf is light for its size, so it floats.
float-sink-object-coconut: Coconut. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-coconut: You guessed it! Its hairy husk is full of air, so it floats.
float-sink-surprise-coconut: Surprise! Its hairy husk is full of air, so it floats.
float-sink-object-rock: Rock. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-rock: You guessed it! A rock is heavy for its size, so it sinks.
float-sink-surprise-rock: Surprise! A rock is heavy for its size, so it sinks.
float-sink-object-shell: Shell. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-shell: You guessed it! Water fills the open shell, so it sinks.
float-sink-surprise-shell: Surprise! Water fills the open shell, so it sinks.
float-sink-object-key: Key. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-key: You guessed it! Metal is heavy for its size. The key sinks.
float-sink-surprise-key: Surprise! Metal is heavy for its size. The key sinks.
float-sink-object-cork: Cork. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-cork: You guessed it! Cork is full of tiny air pockets. It floats!
float-sink-surprise-cork: Surprise! Cork is full of tiny air pockets. It floats!
float-sink-object-apple: Apple. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-apple: You guessed it! An apple has air inside, so it floats!
float-sink-surprise-apple: Surprise! An apple has air inside, so it floats!
float-sink-object-log: Big log. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-log: You guessed it! Wood is light for its size. Even a big log floats!
float-sink-surprise-log: Surprise! Wood is light for its size. Even a big log floats!
float-sink-object-coin: Coin. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-coin: You guessed it! A tiny coin sinks! Metal is heavy for its size.
float-sink-surprise-coin: Surprise! A tiny coin sinks! Metal is heavy for its size.
float-sink-object-sponge: Wet sponge. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-sponge: You guessed it! This soaked sponge is full of water, not air, so it sinks.
float-sink-surprise-sponge: Surprise! This soaked sponge is full of water, not air, so it sinks.
float-sink-object-toy-boat: Toy boat. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-toy-boat: You guessed it! Its hollow shape keeps water out, so it floats.
float-sink-surprise-toy-boat: Surprise! Its hollow shape keeps water out, so it floats.
float-sink-object-spoon: Spoon. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-spoon: You guessed it! A metal spoon is heavy for its size, so it sinks.
float-sink-surprise-spoon: Surprise! A metal spoon is heavy for its size, so it sinks.
float-sink-object-clay: Clay ball. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-clay: You guessed it! A squished clay ball has no room for air. It sinks.
float-sink-surprise-clay: Surprise! A squished clay ball has no room for air. It sinks.
float-sink-object-clay-boat: Clay bowl. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-clay-boat: You guessed it! Same clay, bowl shape! It holds air, so it floats.
float-sink-surprise-clay-boat: Surprise! Same clay, bowl shape! It holds air, so it floats.
float-sink-object-empty-bottle: Empty bottle. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-empty-bottle: You guessed it! Air sealed inside makes the bottle float.
float-sink-surprise-empty-bottle: Surprise! Air sealed inside makes the bottle float.
float-sink-object-full-bottle: Full bottle. Will it float or sink?
float-sink-right-full-bottle: You guessed it! Full of water with no air inside, it sinks.
float-sink-surprise-full-bottle: Surprise! Full of water with no air inside, it sinks.
float-sink-build: Pick a boat. Then add pebbles until it sinks. How many can it hold?
float-sink-load: Tap the pebbles to put one in the boat. Count with me!
float-sink-held-1: Splash! The boat sank. It held one pebble!
float-sink-held-2: Splash! The boat sank. It held two pebbles!
float-sink-held-3: Splash! The boat sank. It held three pebbles!
float-sink-held-4: Splash! The boat sank. It held four pebbles!
float-sink-held-5: Splash! The boat sank. It held five pebbles!
float-sink-held-6: Splash! The boat sank. It held six pebbles!
float-sink-ball-sank: The clay ball sank right away! A ball has no room for air. A bowl shape can hold air and float.
crab-commands-intro: Tap arrows to plan the crab's path. Then press Go!
crab-commands-help: Tap command cards to plan the crab’s path. Watch the footprints. Tap Go to try your plan, then change it if needed.
crab-commands-plan: Get the shell, then go home. Tap arrows to plan the crab's path, then press Go!
crab-commands-bump: Bump! Change the red card, then press Go again.
crab-commands-hint: Here is one plan that works. Tap a hint card to hear it.
